_comment: Monetisation model. The affiliate programmes rejected the publisher, so
the site no longer earns a commission per click. The engine below sells
the same asset three different ways:
1. LEAD_GEN      - a vendor pays for a QUALIFIED intent signal
(destination + trip length + currency). This is the
primary model: it does not need a cookie and it does
not need an approved affiliate account.
2. SPONSORSHIP   - a fixed monthly fee for a clearly-labelled slot.
3. DISPLAY       - ad-network fallback so the site earns something
from passive traffic even with no sponsors.
4. DATA_LICENSE  - the catalogue itself sold as a product.
Every model is optional and off by default. Nothing on the site is
monetised until a network is configured here, so the build never
renders a broken or empty ad slot.

_comment: The intent signal. A visitor who picks a destination, a trip length
and a currency is someone about to buy. This is what a vendor pays
for, and it is worth far more than a click.
